subject: Draft hero + SKU orchestration for AWS Offer — staging assets and AMI readiness
messages:
From: Annie Walker <annie@acme-retail.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS listing kickoff + SKU map attached

Hi Jasmine / Kimberly,

Thanks for jumping in — we're aiming to finalize the Offer page copy and SKU mapping this week so seller ops can start the AMI upload and buyer-path testing. Attached is our current SKU mapping and the internal procurement snippets team wants to surface during checkout (acme_sku_map.xlsx).

As a starter ask: can Redwood propose a short hero line (one sentence), 3 benefit bullets tailored to retail analytics teams, and the one procurement footnote we should add for private offers? We have a co-sell intake already in flight but want the listing copy to map to it.

Tentative timeline: copy final by Friday 7/10, evidence binder link by Monday 7/13, AMI uploaded by 7/20.

Cheers,
Annie Walker
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Acme Retail
Attachment: acme_sku_map.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: Annie Walker <annie@acme-retail.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-08T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + SKU map attached

Hi Annie — thanks for the context and the SKU map. Looping Marissa and Alex for the AMI and product ops side.

Quick pass below (hero + bullets + procurement footnote):
- Hero (short): "Real-time retail inference for personalized customer experiences."
- 3 bullets:
  • High-throughput inference at low latency for in-store and online personalization.
  • Built-in prefix caching and cost controls to keep unit economics predictable.
  • VPC-ready deployment and enterprise access controls for regulated payment data.
- Procurement footnote suggestion: "Usage-based billing is tracked per inference-hour; negotiated private offers may include minimum monthly commitments and separate entitlement SKUs."

Next steps I suggest:
1) Kimberly to confirm pricing-footnote language for procurement teams.
2) Marissa to confirm AMI/AMI tag and the evidence binder items we need for the seller listing.
3) I will turn aws_listing_draft_v1.md into a Drive asset and send a single-file final by Thursday.

Sharing a Drive folder for assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/ACME-AWS-Listing

Happy to hop on a quick 30-min sync if that helps — available 10:30–12 PT tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0123
Attachment: aws_listing_draft_v1.md (markdown)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Annie Walker <annie@acme-retail.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-09T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + SKU map attached

Thanks Jasmine — good start. A couple of quick edits and clarifications: 

- Hero fine but probe for buyer clarity: can we swap to "Low-latency inference for retail personalization at scale" (explicitly calls out scale).
- Bullets: add an example line for cost: "Save up to X% by leveraging KV caching and automatic batching (customer-specific)." We'll replace X with an example once we have token profile.
- Procurement footnote: please add a sentence that private offers require a separate private-seller SKU and may be subject to AWS invoice processing timelines.

Operational note (internal): Marissa, we need the AMI tag convention and the manifest for evidence binder (SOC link, data retention note, integration checklist). I'll fold those into the seller-facing procurement snippet so Acme procurement sees the right gating items.

On sync — I can do tomorrow at 11 PT.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Annie Walker <annie@acme-retail.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-ops@amazon.com, alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + SKU map attached

Hi all — finalizing from the product ops side.

Decisions:
- Final hero line: "Low-latency inference for retail personalization at scale."
- Bullet refinement applied and the cost example will be a placeholder: "Typical savings depend on workload; we'll include a sample token-profile in the evidence binder."
- Procurement footnote (final): "Private offers require a seller-specific SKU; billing is usage-based and may be subject to negotiated minimums and AWS invoice cadence. See evidence binder for metering details."

Action items for next steps:
1) Alex to queue AMI upload and confirm AMI name + tag: redwood-inference-acme-20260720.
2) Jasmine to publish the updated draft to Drive and send to Annie for final sign-off.
3) Kimberly to add procurement snippet to the HubSpot deal (HS-478212).
4) Marketplace-ops@amazon.com — can you confirm any AMI visibility timing constraints for public vs. private offers? If there's an expected propagation delay, we want to bake that into the launch plan.

Attachment: final_listing_assets.zip (images, hero art, sample snippets)

Marissa Cole
Product Marketing | Redwood Inference
Phone: (650) 555-0199
